verdict.rationale: Dual-boot installation is a fair question for a desktop OS, but nothing in the evidence documents installing Fedora Workstation alongside an existing OS. The pack covers only adjacent topics: Boxes virtual machines, a WSL image, and community reports of replacing Windows outright, and none of these count as dual-boot support.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS alongside my existing OS in a dual-boot configuration
